title: California Issues Measles Warning After Infected Passenger Travels Across State
subtitle: Public health officials are working to track potential exposures after an unvaccinated traveler used trains and buses across six counties.

summary.en: California officials have issued an urgent warning regarding potential measles exposure across six counties. An unvaccinated passenger traveled on multiple Amtrak trains and buses throughout the state in September. This incident follows a series of similar mass-exposure events on public transportation across the US. Health experts continue to emphasize the importance of the MMR vaccine as the country faces its largest measles resurgence in decades. Meanwhile, Pennsylvania is struggling with a severe outbreak that has resulted in hundreds of cases and several deaths.
summary.zh: 加州官員針對六個郡可能發生的麻疹暴露風險發布了緊急警告。一名未接種疫苗的乘客於九月搭乘多班美國國鐵列車及巴士橫跨該州。此事件發生在美國各地一系列類似的大眾運輸暴露事件之後。隨著美國面臨數十年來最嚴重的麻疹疫情復燃，衛生專家持續強調MMR疫苗的重要性。與此同時，賓夕法尼亞州正苦於應對嚴重的疫情，該疫情已導致數百人感染及數人死亡。

paragraphs.en: California public health officials have issued an urgent warning to residents after a traveler infected with measles moved through the state. The passenger, who was not vaccinated, traveled across six different counties using Amtrak trains and connecting buses. This event has raised concerns about the spread of the virus, which is highly contagious and can be dangerous for those who have not received the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine—a shot that provides long-term protection against the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 加州公共衛生官員向居民發出緊急警告，因為一名感染麻疹的旅客曾途經該州。這名未接種疫苗的乘客搭乘美國國鐵（Amtrak）列車及接駁巴士，橫跨了六個郡。此事件引發了對病毒傳播的擔憂，麻疹具有高度傳染性，對於未接種麻疹、腮腺炎、德國麻疹混合疫苗（MMR）的人來說可能相當危險，而這款疫苗能提供對抗該疾病的長期保護。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Health, the traveler arrived in Los Angeles on September 10. From there, the individual moved through Bakersfield, Stockton, Oroville, Sacramento, and Emeryville before finally leaving California for Denver. Because of this long journey, health officials are currently working with federal partners and local departments to identify and notify anyone who was on the same trains or buses, or who spent time inside the stations along the route during those dates.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報健康》（The Guardian Health）報導，該名旅客於九月十日抵達洛杉磯。隨後，此人途經貝克斯菲爾德、斯托克頓、奧羅維爾、沙加緬度及埃默里維爾，最後離開加州前往丹佛。由於這趟長途旅程，衛生官員目前正與聯邦合作夥伴及地方部門配合，試圖識別並通知所有在這些日期搭乘同一班列車或巴士，以及曾在沿途車站停留的民眾。

paragraphs.en: This incident is part of a much larger public health challenge currently facing the United States. The country is experiencing its most significant measles resurgence in more than thirty years. Experts point to growing vaccine hesitancy—the choice to delay or refuse vaccinations—as a primary reason for the return of the virus. Rita Nguyen, an assistant state public health officer in California, stated that this case serves as a clear reminder of why vaccination is so important. She noted that the MMR vaccine is safe and protects not only individuals but also those who are too young to receive the vaccine themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 這起事件是美國目前面臨的更廣泛公共衛生挑戰的一部分。該國正經歷三十多年來最嚴重的麻疹疫情復燃。專家指出，疫苗猶豫（即選擇延遲或拒絕接種疫苗）是病毒回歸的主要原因。加州公共衛生助理官員阮麗塔（Rita Nguyen）表示，此案例清楚提醒了疫苗接種的重要性。她指出，MMR疫苗安全可靠，不僅能保護個人，也能保護那些年紀太小而無法自行接種疫苗的族群。

paragraphs.en: California is not the only state dealing with such risks. Just this week, reports emerged of another person with measles traveling on an Amtrak train from Missouri to Illinois. That single trip resulted in more than 250 people being exposed to the virus in one county alone. These incidents highlight the difficulty of controlling the spread of measles when infected individuals travel across large distances using public transportation.
paragraphs.zh: 加州並非唯一面臨此類風險的州。就在本週，有報導指出另一名麻疹患者搭乘美國國鐵列車從密蘇里州前往伊利諾州。僅僅這一趟旅程，就導致單一郡內超過兩百五十人暴露於病毒風險中。這些事件凸顯了當感染者利用大眾運輸工具進行長距離移動時，控制麻疹傳播的困難度。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the situation in Pennsylvania remains critical. The state is currently managing the worst active outbreak in the country, with 731 confirmed cases across 38 counties so far this year. Tragically, at least four people in Pennsylvania have died from illnesses related to the measles virus. State officials have reached out to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) for emergency help. However, there is tension regarding this request. Officials have warned that they might withdraw the request for help unless the CDC officially recognizes the four deaths linked to the outbreak. This comes after US health secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. previously told the CDC not to classify these deaths as measles-related.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，賓夕法尼亞州的局勢依然危急。該州目前正處理全國最嚴重的現行疫情，今年至今已有三十八個郡累計七百三十一例確診。令人遺憾的是，賓州至少已有四人死於與麻疹病毒相關的疾病。州政府官員已向美國疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）請求緊急援助。然而，這項請求引發了緊張關係。官員警告，除非CDC正式承認這四起死亡案例與疫情有關，否則他們可能會撤回援助請求。在此之前，美國衛生部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）曾指示CDC不要將這些死亡案例歸類為麻疹相關。

paragraphs.en: Adding to the complexity of the situation, the Trump administration has recently changed the way measles deaths are counted. The CDC is now using data from the National Center for Health Statistics to track mortality, which is a change from previous methods. This shift in reporting has caused confusion among health experts who are trying to understand the true scale of the crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 更複雜的是，川普（Donald Trump）政府近期改變了麻疹死亡案例的統計方式。CDC目前改用國家衛生統計中心的數據來追蹤死亡率，這與過去的方法不同。這種報告方式的轉變，讓試圖釐清危機真實規模的衛生專家感到困惑。

paragraphs.en: During a recent conference for Children’s Health Defense, an organization he led for nearly ten years, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. spoke about the outbreak. While he acknowledged the deaths, he spent much of his time speaking against vaccines. His comments have frustrated many in the medical community who are working to encourage the public to get vaccinated. Health experts argue that the focus should remain on stopping the spread of the disease through proven medical science.
paragraphs.zh: 在近期一場由他領導近十年的組織「兒童健康防衛」（Children’s Health Defense）所舉辦的會議上，小羅伯特·甘迺迪談到了此次疫情。儘管他承認了死亡案例，但他大部分時間都在發表反對疫苗的言論。他的言論讓許多致力於鼓勵民眾接種疫苗的醫學界人士感到沮喪。衛生專家主張，重點應放在透過經證實的醫學科學來阻止疾病傳播。

paragraphs.en: As the number of cases continues to rise, the message from public health departments remains consistent: vaccination is the most effective way to prevent further outbreaks. For now, California officials are focused on tracing the path of the infected passenger to prevent any further spread. Residents who were in the affected areas are being urged to check their vaccination records and contact their doctors if they show any symptoms of the illness. With measles cases appearing in multiple states, the coming weeks will be a major test for the nation’s public health system.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著病例數持續攀升，公共衛生部門傳達的訊息始終如一：疫苗接種是預防疫情進一步擴散最有效的方法。目前，加州官員正致力於追蹤該名感染乘客的路線，以防止疫情擴散。當局呼籲曾身處受影響地區的居民檢查疫苗接種紀錄，若出現任何疾病症狀，應立即聯繫醫師。隨著多州出現麻疹病例，未來幾週將成為美國公共衛生體系的一大考驗。

keyTerms.noteZh: 並非字面上的「伸手」，而是指主動聯繫請求幫忙。文中：State officials have reached out to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) for emergency help.

previousArticles.title: Public Health Challenges: Measles Spreads in the US and West Nile Virus Grows in Europe
previousArticles.summaryEn: Public health officials in the United States are managing a major measles outbreak that has spread across multiple states. Meanwhile, Italy is seeing an increase in West Nile virus cases as warmer weather helps mosquitoes thrive. Experts warn that both situations are made worse by environmental and social factors. In the US, vaccine hesitancy is a primary concern for health authorities. In Europe, climate change is extending the season for mosquito-borne diseases.

quiz.question: According to the article, what specific action are California health officials taking in response to the infected traveler?

options.A: They are mandating immediate MMR vaccinations for all residents in the six affected counties.
options.B: They are working with federal and local partners to identify and contact people who were in contact with the traveler.
options.C: They are closing Amtrak stations across the state to prevent further spread of the virus.
options.D: They are officially classifying the incident as the worst measles outbreak in California's history.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，衛生官員正在與聯邦及地方部門合作，追蹤並通知所有與該名旅客搭乘相同交通工具或曾出現在車站的人。選項 A 錯誤，文中並未提到強制全民接種疫苗；選項 C 錯誤，文中提到的是追蹤接觸者，而非關閉車站；選項 D 錯誤，文中提到最嚴重的疫情是在賓州，而非加州。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the current relationship between the CDC and state officials in Pennsylvania?

options.A: The CDC has already provided all the emergency resources requested by Pennsylvania.
options.B: Pennsylvania officials are satisfied with how the federal government is counting measles-related deaths.
options.C: There is a disagreement regarding the recognition of measles deaths that is affecting the request for federal aid.
options.D: The CDC is currently leading the response in Pennsylvania without any input from local state officials.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第五段，賓州官員威脅若 CDC 不承認與疫情相關的四起死亡案例，他們可能會撤回援助請求，這顯示雙方在死亡案例認定上有嚴重分歧。選項 A 與事實相反；選項 B 錯誤，因為賓州官員對此感到不滿且有爭議；選項 D 錯誤，文中並未說明 CDC 完全接管，且雙方目前處於緊張關係中。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, the author describes the current situation in Pennsylvania as 'critical'. What does 'critical' mean in this context?

options.A: Expressing a negative judgment or disapproval.
options.C: Essential for the success of a project.
options.D: A turning point that is likely to be positive.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境下，「critical」用來形容賓州疫情的嚴峻程度，意指情況非常危急或嚴重。選項 A 是「批判的」之意，在此不適用；選項 C 指的是「關鍵的/不可或缺的」，不符合描述疫情嚴重性的語境；選項 D 指的是轉捩點，文中並未暗示疫情即將好轉，反而強調其嚴重性。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article?

options.A: The US public health system is successfully eliminating measles through strict travel restrictions.
options.B: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is the main cause of the measles resurgence in the United States.
options.C: Public transportation is the only way measles spreads across state lines.
options.D: Measles is resurging due to vaccine hesitancy, creating significant public health challenges that require a focus on vaccination.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章整體探討了麻疹疫情在美國的復甦，歸因於疫苗猶豫（vaccine hesitancy），並強調疫苗接種是預防疫情擴散的最有效手段。選項 A 與事實相反，疫情正在惡化；選項 B 過於偏頗，雖然文中提到他的言論，但並非文章核心；選項 C 錯誤，文中並未說這是「唯一」途徑，僅指出其增加了控制難度。
